messages.subject: Reminder of meeting today, 12-2
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies,
This is a reminder that our first meeting of the new quarter is today at noon. We'll have a hybrid format so you can join us in the Datalab classroom (360 Shields library) or via zoom (link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862)

We will discuss plans and topics for the quarter, then move into a group study session where folks with questions can get support from one of our expeRts.

Please remember that you can always get help by posting your questions to our discussion forum at https://d-rug.discourse.group

-Your cooRdinators
